हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: Set in the vibrant city of Varanasi, the story follows Aman, a simple desi saree salesman deeply rooted in the culture and spirit of Banaras, and Shaily, a modern, educated businesswoman who owns a leading Banarasi saree brand and shopping mall. Coming from completely different worlds, their journey unfolds through love, clashes, and emotions while celebrating the rich traditions, language, and colorful lifestyle of Banaras.
